page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-384-metal is a bare-metal server instance belonging to the c4d server family. It features 384 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The system is equipped with 3072.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. This instance does not include integrated local storage or bundled GPUs, and it provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Positioned as a high-capacity bare-metal offering, this server represents a premium hardware class designed for workloads requiring massive resource density. The absence of built-in local storage means storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage, which represents a key architectural tradeoff. The qualitative cost profile reflects its position as an enterprise-grade, high-density compute and memory platform.

Given the substantial memory capacity of over three terabytes and 384 dedicated vCPUs, this server is designed for large-scale enterprise workloads. Suitable applications include massive in-memory databases, large-scale data processing, enterprise resource planning systems, and heavy virtualization workloads that require direct bare-metal access to hardware resources without hypervisor overhead.
